title: The House
house: A classical house about a hundred years old, renovated with light by one woman who adores Sanzo Wada's book: tall arched French windows, panelled walls, white coffered ceilings, pale stone floors, warm brass. Bright, symmetrical and generous, with one palette in each room. Her best friend, an architectural photographer, shoots every room straight on, in its best light.
ruled_out: Left out: combinations that read as a graphic rather than a room, and pairs of two loud colours with nothing soft to rest on.

rooms.name: Living room
rooms.about: The room that sets the house: pale blue panelling, a cinnamon velvet sofa, two yellow chairs, morning light through arched windows.

rooms.name: Entrance hall
rooms.about: Seen from the living room. Stone floor, a staircase, the first impression.

options.idea: Ivory and a soft mineral grey; calm, so every room off it can shine.
Pale pink, pale lemon and a warm grey.
Olive buff, pale aqua, soft blue and one clear teal.

rooms.name: Dining room
rooms.about: Long table, candles, dinners that run late.

options.idea: Carmine with pale lemon and a soft grey: the bathroom's idea, grown up for candlelight.
Deep red, pale lemon, a clear aqua and warm grey.
Spinel pink, ivory and a soft olive.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.about: Morning light, a big table, used every day.

options.idea: Pale lemon and one orange, with mint and a soft blue.
Coral, cream yellow, mint and a clear aqua.
Seashell pink, a citron yellow and a pale grey-green.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.about: Books, a fire, a reading chair. It can be deeper than the rest.

options.idea: Bright yellow and mint with a deep clear blue.
Soft pink and pale blue with a strong cerulean.
Cream yellow, ecru and pale aqua with a deep clear blue.

rooms.name: Morning room
rooms.about: Breakfast and letters in east light. Fresh and gentle.

options.idea: Ivory, yellow orange and a soft lavender.
Two soft pinks and a clear aqua.
Pale sulphur and cream yellow, a deep green and a soft blue.

rooms.name: Study
rooms.about: A smaller room for work and thinking.

options.idea: A golden khaki, a clear aqua and a soft lavender.
Warm buff, a light mauve and a calm grey.
Pink and a muted gold with two clear blues.

rooms.name: Garden room
rooms.about: Glass on two sides, plants, the garden coming in.

options.idea: Seashell pink, olive, a spring green and a clear blue.
Lime, sea green, mint and aqua: the garden itself.
Pale sulphur, one peach red and two spring greens.

rooms.name: Main bedroom
rooms.about: Quiet, soft, personal. Morning light through linen.

options.idea: Dusty rose, soft salmon and a pale turquoise.
Soft pink, a clear sea green and a light mauve.
Pink, golden yellow and a cinnamon brown.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.about: A roll-top bath under a window. Small enough to be bold.

options.idea: Spinel pink, pale lemon and a soft grey.
Old rose and soft cinnamon with sage and a sea green.
Coral pink, Naples yellow and a porcelain green.
